answer_1.quote: Simultaneous machine translation (SiMT) translates input in real-time by incrementally processing partial segments rather than waiting the whole sentence completion.
models: Transformer with Hubert-Large encoder and mBART50 decoder
answer_1.outputs: Japanese translations generated incrementally with minimal latency

answer_2.quote: Evaluation Metrics Table shows a list of translation quality evaluation used in our experiments: BLEU, BLEURT, COMET, and COMET-QE. For latency evaluation, we choose Average Lagging (AL), Length Adaptive Average Lagging (LAAL), and Average Token Delay (ATD).
